question: What claim about designation requires beings called family-impellers to be named as caturyuga in this address to the independent lord of gods?
premises: They are addressed in relation to the independent lord of gods.
They are named by the term caturyuga.
inference: The family-impellers are designated by the name caturyuga, O independent lord of gods.
plain_english: Caturyuga, thus, O independent lord of gods, are the family-impellers.
